channel.title: Is Robert Scranton from 3001 106?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Is Robert Scranton from 3001 106?" - I remember reading a very """Vile""" joke test log and it referred to 106 as Robert Scranton.

item.title: Re: Is Robert Scranton from 3001 106?
item.content:encoded: I thought it was an exceptionally good crossover. Especially when Dr. Scranton mentioned a "black gel he's been swimming through" in 3001. But does this mean that SCP-106's pocket dimension is a form of 3001, or at least a part of it? Food for thought. For the sake of your sanity if you read the test log I reccomend Class-A amnestics and/or just skip to the 106 and 4666 one. Eugh.

item.title: Re: Is Robert Scranton from 3001 106?
item.content:encoded: In the tale Until Death, yes, 106 is meant to be Dr. Scranton, altered by his time in the void of 3001. As I'm sure you've heard, though, "there is no canon," except what is internally consistent in whatever article you're reading at the time. Until Death represents one author playing "what if?" with two previously unrelated articles.

item.title: Is Robert Scranton from 3001 106?
item.content:encoded: Not only that, I read the tale Until Death and it talked about 3001 and 106. Could Dr. Scranton be SCP-106? I kind of doubt it as I headcanoned the tale The Young Man however i remember reading a thread about how 106 was contained in the 1950-70's before they had technology to contain 106. Very confused could use some help
